name: worldmonitor
description: World Monitor agent plugin: live global-intelligence MCP servers plus task-focused agent skills for country risk, conflict, markets, chokepoints, energy, climate, and related situational awareness.

interface.longDescription: Explore source-attributed news, country risk, conflicts, markets, energy and maritime chokepoints with WorldMonitor tools and task-focused skills. Browse curated news panels and a 2D map or 3D globe, search headlines, and summarize or translate selected headlines. Data can be partial, stale or unavailable; answers retain coverage and attribution. Connect your WorldMonitor account through OAuth. This plugin reads intelligence data and does not trade, publish articles or modify source records. Map controls work in the UI; model control of an already-open map depends on host support.
defaultPrompt: Show today’s world headlines with sources and coverage.
Translate one current headline into Arabic.
